items.title: Angola Talking Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And, Maxie, what was your first instrument?

ctx.x: They were all six-string, but they weren't rapped. Mm-hmm. Just plain naked string, copper wire.
Oh, I see. Just like these strings, not like a five-string banjo. That's right, yeah. I see. And, Maxie, what was your first instrument?
